narrative: 一个身材矮小的成年人和一位体型正常的主人同坐一张桌子。这张桌子按两种比例搭建而成。
从一个固定镜头的角度看，两人仿佛在共进一餐；一旦偏离这个轴线，接缝就露馅了。
照片本身看起来很平常，但尺寸数据并不平常。
用它来改变体型大小，而不借助数字缩放：霍比特人站在成年人身旁、成年演员置身放大版的童年厨房、一座微缩城市与实拍前景对齐。奇幻效果始终存在于一张照片之内。
对于自由移动的摄影机来说，除非几何关系通过运动控制精确匹配，否则它就用错了工具。如果你实际搭建了一个代表整个世界的微缩模型（那是微缩模型 Diorama），或者用倾斜的焦平面伪造微缩尺度（那是移轴 Tilt-Shift），也同样用错了工具。
how: 先确定观看位置。让身材矮小的演员离摄影机更远，或让高大的演员离得更近，并按比例搭建他们要接触的置景物件。
匹配视线和落地点，把两个不同的距离当作同一个空间来打光。
锁定摄影机，或者只沿着能保持对齐关系的路径移动。提示词：in-camera scale by placement, shared table or floor, coherent eyelines, not a digital resize。
when: 一位矮小的成年宾客和一位体型正常的主人同坐一张乡村风格的桌子，摄影机锁定，双手双脚共用按比例搭建的家具。不要围绕这两人做环绕运镜。
换一个新角度就会破坏这种对齐关系。
vs: 微缩模型（Diorama）拍摄的是代表宏大世界的实体模型；强制透视通常使用处于不同距离的真人。
移轴（Tilt-Shift）用一个真实风景上的薄焦平面伪造玩具般的尺度；深焦（Deep Focus）常常配合强制透视使用，让两种尺度都保持清晰。
同屏分身（Duplication）复制的是一个人；强制透视复制的是一种尺寸关系。
examples_film: 《指环王：护戒使者》（The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring）通过距离和按比例搭建的道具，把真人和霍比特人安排在同一构图中；《美丽心灵的永恒阳光》（Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind）把乔尔置于放大版的房间里，显得像个孩子。
这些是视点构造，不是可以直接照搬的画面。
mistakes: 错误的近亲：移轴微缩效果，或者一个被数字缩放却接触阴影不对的人物。破绽：脚悬空、视线对不上、虚焦暴露了真实距离，或者摄影机自由环绕拍摄。
解决办法：单一轴线、按比例的接触点、匹配的光线，以及足够深的景深，让两种尺度都显得真实可信。

faq.q: 电影中的强制透视是什么？
faq.a: 一种视点技巧：通过距离、调度和置景比例，让人或物看起来比实际更大或更小。这种效果只在拍摄机位成立，换个角度就会露馅。

faq.q: 强制透视 vs 移轴
faq.a: 强制透视用几何关系改变表观尺寸；移轴则倾斜焦平面，让真实场景看起来像玩具。一个用位置说谎，另一个用焦点说谎。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用强制透视？
faq.a: 当两种尺度必须共存于一张照片，而又不借助数字缩小时使用它。如果摄影机必须离开设计好的轴线自由游走，就不要用它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写强制透视的提示词？
faq.a: 说明锁定的摄影机、两种尺度、共用的家具或地面、匹配的视线和接触阴影，并明确禁止自由摄影机运动和简单缩放。

narrative: A small adult sits at a table with a full-sized host. The table is built in two scales.
From one locked lens they share a meal. Move off the axis and the join shows.
The photograph looks ordinary. The measurements are not.
Use it to change size without a digital shrink: a hobbit beside a man, a grown actor in a giant childhood kitchen, a miniature city aligned with a live foreground. Fantasy stays inside a photograph.

It is the wrong tool for a free-moving camera unless the geometry is motion-controlled to match. It is also the wrong tool when you actually built a miniature of the whole world (that is diorama) or when you faked miniature scale with a tilted plane of focus (that is tilt-shift).
how: Choose the viewing position first. Place the small performer farther from camera, or the large one nearer, and scale the set pieces they touch.
Match eyelines and ground contact. Light both distances as one space.
Lock the camera, or move only on a path that preserves alignment. Prompt: in-camera scale by placement, shared table or floor, coherent eyelines, not a digital resize.
when: A tiny adult guest and a normal host at one rustic table, locked camera, feet and hands sharing scaled furniture. Do not orbit the pair.
A new angle will break the alignment.
vs: Diorama photographs a physical model standing in for a large world. Forced perspective usually uses real people at different distances.
Tilt-Shift fakes toy scale with a thin focus plane on a real landscape. Deep Focus often supports forced perspective so both scales stay sharp.
Duplication copies a person. Forced perspective copies a size relationship.
examples_film: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring seats humans and hobbits in shared compositions by distance and scaled props. Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind puts Joel child-sized inside enlarged rooms.
Those are viewpoint constructions, not frames to duplicate.
mistakes: Wrong cousin: tilt-shift miniature look, or a person digitally scaled with wrong contact shadows. Tell: feet hover, eyelines miss, blur betrays true distance, or the camera freely orbits.
Fix: one axis, scaled contact, matched light, deep enough focus to sell both sizes.

faq.q: What is forced perspective in film?
faq.a: A viewpoint trick: distance, staging, and set scale make people or objects look larger or smaller than they are. It holds from the taking camera, not from every angle.
Forced perspective changes apparent size with geometry. Tilt-shift tilts the focus plane so a real scene looks like a toy. One lies about scale with placement. The other lies with focus.

faq.q: When should I use forced perspective?
faq.a: When two scales must share one photograph without a digital shrink. Do not use it if the camera must roam off the designed axis.

faq.q: How do I prompt forced perspective for AI image or video?
faq.a: Specify locked camera, two scales, shared furniture or ground, matching eyelines and contact shadows. Forbid free camera moves and simple resize.
